text:
Mina: Heads up9 flying into SF Thurs evening, staying by Embarcadero. Any low-key dinner recs for 3 ppl? not rooftop.
Carlos: Fog City Diner is reliable and casual, short walk from the Ferry Building.
Leah: For something different try Ramen Dojo on Embarcadero West (spicy tonkotsu).
Mina: Anyone open late-ish? arriving around 9pm.
Carlos: Ramen Dojo is open till 11. If you want cocktails + small plates, The Interval is a bit further but open late.
Leah: If you prefer picnic style, grab sandwiches at Gott's and eat on the piers.
ops-bot: FYI Office dinner allowance policy: meals under $60 per person can be expensed for visiting engineers with manager approval.
Mina: Nice, thanks. Also, @Jon - any good breakfast near our downtown hotel?
Jon: Blue Bottle at the Ferry Building for coffee, and Gott's breakfast sandwich is solid.
Leah: If you want pastries, Craftsman & Wolves on Market is excellent.
Mina: Heads-up I'm also in London next month near Shoreditch. Quick late-night curry recs?
Carlos: Tayyabs if you're willing to travel; Brick Lane has late spots but busy.
Leah: For something quieter, Dishoom opens early/late-ish and is great for groups. Book ahead.
Mina: Thanks all! Quick poll: who wants to meet Fri 1pm for a lunch walkthrough at the SF office? react with :white_check_mark: for yes
Carlos: :white_check_mark:
Leah: :white_check_mark:
Jon: Maybe, will know after meetings.
ops-bot: Event added to #lunch-plans calendar: "SF visitor lunch - Fri 13:00"
Mina: I'll DM anyone who RSVPs with location. Cheers :raised_hands:
